summary.text: Steve Riley is a Republican state representative who has represented Kentucky House of Representatives District 23 since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former educator and school administrator from Glasgow, he earned his degrees at Western Kentucky University.

paragraphs.text: Steve Riley was born on June 23, 1958, and as of February 2020 lived in Glasgow, Kentucky.
He earned a bachelor of arts in history and government and a master's degree in history and education from Western Kentucky University.

His career experience includes working as an educator and a Rank I school administrator, and he has been a member of the Glasgow-Barren County Chamber of Commerce, the Glasgow Rotary Club and the Kentucky High School Athletic Association Board of Control.
Riley took office in the Kentucky House in 2017.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Appropriations and Revenue, Committee on Families and Children, Health and Family Services, and Primary and Secondary Education committees.
The Republican primary for his seat on May 19, 2026, was canceled.
